Mali.title: Australia’s Sanctions on West Bank Settlers Increase Pressure
Mali.summary: Australia announced on November 18 further targeted sanctions on three individuals and four entities involved in illegal settlement expansion and human rights abuses against Palestinians in the West Bank. Although these sanctions are a welcome step, they are long overdue and don’t go far enough. The situation in the West Bank is dire.

Mali.title: Mali: JNIM Resistance at Niono Costs Government Troops Dearly Despite Air Support
Mali.summary: Mali's armed forces have suffered another blow in the centre of the country. According to an RFI Hausa report, an attack by fighters of Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM) in the town of Niono left a number of Malian soldiers dead. The report says the troops met strong resistance from the jihadists despite support from combat aircraft.

Mali.title: Mali: Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin attacks army and African Corps positions in the centre of the country
Mali.summary: On Saturday, the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) attacked at least two positions of the Malian army and the forces of the Russian Africa Corps in the Ségou region in central Mali, resulting in several casualties among the army, according to Radio France Internationale. The radio station reported that the attackers arrived on motorcycles, in vehicles and on foot, and targeted key military positions in the Niono region, where fierce clashes took place, and burning vehicles were seen inside one of the camps.

Mali.title: NIONO: The FAMa intensify strikes against terrorist positions following the attack on the town, with several targets neutralised
Mali.summary: Niono: The FAMa strike several terrorist positions as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Operation Dougoukoloko: Three waves of airstrikes against armed terrorist groups. The Malian army continues security operations around Niono.

Mali.title: As risks escalate in the Sahel region… the Algerian army seizes attack drones near the border with Mali
Mali.summary: Algiers - Al-Quds Al-Arabi: The Algerian army announced the discovery of a hideout containing an arsenal of weapons and ammunition in the area of Bordj Badji Mokhtar, in the far south of the country, near the border with Mali. This operation attracted attention due to the nature of the seized equipment, which is not limited to conventional weapons but also includes attack drones, at a time when the Sahel region is witnessing an increase in the use of drones by armed groups and a rise in the activity of arms smuggling networks.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: FAMa: Several strikes against terrorist groups in the Kidal and Niono regions
Mali.summary: Bamako, 22 November (AMAP) The National Defence Forces, with the support of their partners, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, carried out several strikes against terrorist groups between 18 and 21 November 2023, in the Kidal and Niono regions, according to a statement from the Armed Forces General Staff. . The press release states that, on Wednesday, 18 November, thanks to intelligence, the army identified a meeting place for armed terrorist groups 119 km south-west of Kidal, and then struck it after confirming the target.

Mali.title: Mali: The FAMa strike several terrorist positions around Niono
Mali.summary: On Saturday, 21 November 2026, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) carried out several waves of airstrikes against positions held by armed terrorist groups in the vicinity of Niono, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced. According to the military statement, these operations specifically targeted fighters involved in the attack on the town of Niono.

Mali.title: Niono: The Malian army announces three waves of strikes against armed groups
Mali.summary: The Malian army claims to have struck several positions of armed groups around Niono on Saturday, 21 November. According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, these groups had taken part in the attack on the town. The strikes took place in three waves.

Mali.title: Douentza: Rural women in the spotlight
Mali.summary: This Thursday, the Maison des Arts et de la Culture in Douentza hosted a meeting dedicated to recognising the contribution of women to rural activities. Coming from the various municipalities and localities of the region, they displayed cereals from their own production. .

Mali.title: Mali: JNIM jihadists attack the army and its auxiliaries in the Ségou region
Mali.summary: At least two positions of the Malian army and its Russian partners from Africa Corps were attacked on Saturday, 21 November 2026, in the centre of the country. The Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) claimed responsibility for these attacks, which resulted in several casualties among the army's ranks. .

Mali.title: NEWS Souleymane SIDIBE Article reserved for our subscribers Niono, Sofara, Kidal and Niafunké: The army strikes down terrorist groups
Mali.summary: The document states that, on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, a camp belonging to armed terrorist groups, housing several individuals as well as logistical equipment including motorcycles, was targeted by precision strikes fifteen kilometres southeast of Niono. On the same day, in the Sofara area, a terrorist pick-up truck concealed under a tree was neutralised, with a secondary explosion...

Burkina Faso.title: Maxillofacial surgery: Burkina Faso is strengthening its expertise to treat injured patients locally who were previously evacuated abroad
Burkina Faso.summary: Thanks to the expertise of Burkinabé specialists, complex surgical procedures are now being carried out in Burkina Faso for the benefit of war-wounded and civilian patients. Some of these operations previously required medical evacuations abroad. This breakthrough was made possible through collaboration with an expert from abroad, during the first maxillofacial and plastic surgery campaign, held from 16 to 20 November 2026 at the Capitaine Halassane Coulibaly Military Hospital in Ouagadougou.

Burkina Faso.title: Fire at the ZACA project: The Minister of Security calls for compliance with the regulations for transporting hazardous goods
Burkina Faso.summary: On Friday, 20 November 2026, the Minister of Security, Comrade Mahamadou SANA, visited the site of the fire that occurred at the ZACA project in Ouagadougou, in order to assess the damage and familiarise himself with the situation alongside the security forces. According to initial findings, the fire, which broke out the previous day at around 7 p.m., was reportedly linked to poorly packaged insecticides and not to explosives.

Niger.title: Niger: Two individuals neutralised and a logistics base dismantled in Tillabéri
Niger.summary: According to a statement from the institution, the operation was carried out jointly by the Torodi National Guard squadron and the Alpha Zero unit, as part of offensive operations to secure the national territory. The provisional toll stands at two individuals neutralised and five AK-47-type assault rifles recovered. Three motorbikes were also seized, while two other motorbikes and a bicycle were destroyed.
